test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Six classmates T, U, V, W, X and Y each scored different marks in an entrance examination. V scored more than only T and X. W scored less than only U. X did not score the least. The one who scored the third highest marks, scored 91 marks. X scored 72 marks.

Which of the following could possibly be V's score?
solution:
According to the given information-

1. V scored more than only T and X. W scored less than only U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79426f58ad4d95d1beaf91f5f87c008f9fd3a874b84f716feca266005c37418f.png] 

2. X did not score the least. So, Case I is eliminated.

The one who scored the third highest marks, scored 91 marks. X scored 72 marks.

Final arrangement will be-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00cb2a3d620ef153e5f4ccc507eedd9217909eb73021fc974a457fa0dcf3cbdf.png] 

Thus, V's score should be more than 72 and less than 91.

Hence, **'option 2' **is the correct answer.
